num_slabs: <int> Number of surplus slabs available in inventory.
num_orders: <int> Number of customer orders in the order book.
num_colors: <int> Number of distinct finishing-line route codes across all orders.
max_colors_per_knapsack: <int> Maximum number of distinct colors permitted among orders assigned to any single slab.
slab_weights: <list[float], length num_slabs> Weight capacity of each slab.
order_weights: <list[float], length num_orders> Weight of each customer order.
order_colors: <list[int], length num_orders> Finishing-line route code (color) assigned to each order.
eligible_slabs_per_order: <list[list[int]], length num_orders> Indices of slabs eligible to supply each order, based on quality grade and dimension compatibility.
